subject: QBR renewal: compact demo split + handoff protocol
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@cobalthealth.com>, Jon Park <jon.park@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR renewal: compact demo split + handoff protocol

Hi Amelia / Jon —

Thanks again for the time today. We want to make the renewal QBR as useful as possible for your execs and engineers, so proposed approach below:

- Option A (Exec highlight): 25 minutes — top-line results, ROI slides, 2-minute customer vignette; recording + short transcript.
- Option B (Tech deep-dive): 45–60 minutes — architecture, performance benchmarks, migration plan, and open Q&A.

Can you confirm whether your execs prefer a single 45-minute block or the split Option A + B on different days? If split, suggested windows:
- Exec highlight: Tue 8/3 10:00–10:25 PDT or Wed 8/4 16:00–16:25 PDT
- Tech deep-dive: Thu 8/5 09:00–10:00 PDT or Fri 8/6 13:00–14:00 PDT

Attachments: demo-deck-v3.pdf (draft), qbr-runbook.md (ops checklist). I also attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) for the renewal timeline.

If legal needs the SOW redlines ahead of the session, loop them in and we’ll surface the clip of compliance slides up front.

If you confirm times, I will send invites and label host/backup.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

-----
On Sat, 25 Jul 2026 at 11:00 AM, Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@cobalthealth.com> wrote:

> Hi Ben —
>
> Appreciate the options. Execs have a hard 45-minute window on Tue 8/3 at 10:00 PDT (they cannot split into two separate same-week slots).
>
> Would it be possible to compress the agenda to: 25 minutes executive highlights + 15 minutes live Q&A (we can take detailed technical follow-ups with the engineering team in the separate deep-dive)? If you prefer a single 45-minute run, that works too.
>
> A couple of asks before the session:
> 1) Can you remove any real PHI examples from the deck (we'll provide anonymized samples).
> 2) Please include a short SOC2 / retention slide or attach SOC2 evidence; our security team will want to review it in parallel.
> 3) Send the runbook/ops checklist so we can confirm hosts and recording policy.
>
> I cc'd contracts because they want to track the SOW timing.
>
> Thanks —
> Amelia Rios
> Head of Platform Ops, Cobalt Health
> amelia.rios@cobalthealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: QBR renewal: compact demo split + handoff protocol — internal ops

Team —

Amelia has a 45-minute hard window and prefers a compressed executive highlight + Q&A within that block. We need to be surgical. Proposed internal plan:

- Hosts: Ben (exec highlight), Naomi (brief demo + handoff to tech), Priyom (backup and run the live Q&A moderation).
- Recording: capture exec highlight + short transcript. Note: Cobalt asked for no PHI examples; scrub deck accordingly.
- Pre-reads: demo-deck-v3.pdf (redacted), qbr-runbook.md (ops checklist). I uploaded MAP and a draft runbook to the shared Drive (link in metadata).
- Legal/procurement: Lauren, can you nudge contracts for a quick SOW check? The deal team would like to have any outstanding redlines addressed the day before the exec session.
- Contingency: If execs push to 60 minutes, we will widen Q&A. If they insist on 25-min only, we will record and offer a separate deep-dive date.

Action items:
1) Naomi: strip PHI examples and mark any slides with customer names as anonymized — due Mon 7/27 EOD.
2) Priyom: finalize runbook and attendee host list, add dial-in + recording policy — due Mon 7/27 11:00 PDT.
3) Lauren: confirm contracts loop status and push for SOW ack — due Tue 7/28 12:00 PDT.

I will draft the calendar invite once we have confirmation; include recording + transcript consent in the invite.

Thanks —
Ben
